nodes.label: Root-level PUBLIC include of main/ into flight_core
nodes.rationale: flight_core declares no dependency on main/ and uses __has_include("app_config.h") (see fc_features.h) — 'use it if present'. The decision of whether it IS present belongs to the application, so the path-opening command lives at the repo root, not in the component's own CMakeLists. It is a PATH change, not a FLAG-VALUE change, so it does not require cmake to re-run when flags are edited; flag values flow through #include and ninja tracks them via the compiler depfile. PUBLIC (not PRIVATE) is mandatory: any component consuming flight_core headers must see the same path so every #if in a driver header evaluates identically on both sides — PRIVATE would compile flight_core without a function while src/ believes it exists, producing baffling link errors.
